box.name: Instrument panel junction block
box.where: Left side of the instrument panel, lower dash (manual page 70-2, view D). Multi-purpose fuses 1 to 16 plus dedicated fuses 15 to 18.
box.source: Mitsubishi Eclipse service manual, Group 90 pages 90-13 to 90-18 and Group 70 page 70-2
box.caption: LOWER DASH · LEFT SIDE

bat.name: Constant
bat.desc: Live with the key out. Anything here can drain the battery.

acc.name: Accessory
acc.desc: Live with the key at ACC and ON. Dies when you pull the key.

ig.name: Ignition
ig.desc: Live with the ignition ON (IG1 or IG2).

slots.name: DEF/CHOKE
slots.what: Rear defogger and choke coil (Pink 30 A).

slots.name: A/C-BLWR
slots.what: Automatic A/C compressor controller, resistor and blower motor (Pink 30 A).

slots.name: PCM-B
slots.what: Powertrain control module, ABS-ECU, stoplights, auto-cruise control-ECU and immobilizer-ECU (Blue 15 A).
Empty position.

slots.name: PCM-IG1
slots.what: Powertrain control module, input and output shaft speed sensors, backup lights, SRS-ECU and ETACS-ECU. Powered from IG1 (Red 10 A).
Empty position.

slots.name: ACC SOCKET
slots.what: Cigarette lighter, accessory socket, remote-controlled mirrors and multi-center display unit (Blue 15 A).

slots.name: ETACS-ACC
slots.what: ETACS-ECU and dedicated fuse 18 (Yellow 20 A).
slots.note: Power source read from a merged table cell (ACC); confirm on the car.

slots.name: TOP/ABS
slots.what: Convertible top control module and ABS-ECU. Powered from IG2 (Red 10 A).
slots.note: The convertible top applies to the Spyder only.

slots.name: HORN
slots.what: Horn, horn relay, theft-alarm horn and its relay (Red 10 A).

slots.name: DLC/METER
slots.what: Data link connector, ETACS-ECU and combination meter (Blue 15 A).
slots.note: The data link connector is the OBD port: this fuse is the one to check if the ELM327 dongle gets no power.

slots.name: ANTENNA
slots.what: Motor antenna assembly. Powered from IG1 (Red 10 A).
slots.note: Listed for the Spyder only in the manual.

slots.name: METER-IG1
slots.what: Combination meter, ETACS-ECU, SRS-ECU, auto-cruise control-ECU, column-ECU, multi-center display and vehicle speed sensor. Powered from IG1 (Red 10 A).
Empty position.
Empty position.

slots.name: HVAC-IG2
slots.what: Blower relay, air-selection damper motor, defogger relay, A/C switch, front-ECU, A/C compressor relay and automatic compressor controller. Powered from IG2 (Red 10 A).

slots.name: DED15 AMP
slots.what: Dedicated fuse 15: audio system on vehicles with an amplifier (Yellow 20 A, fed through fusible link 4).
slots.note: Numbered 100 + the manual number, so the engine-bay dedicated fuses 1 to 14 can be added later as 101 to 114.

slots.what: Dedicated position 16: empty.

slots.name: DED17 S/ROOF
slots.what: Dedicated fuse 17: sunroof (Yellow 20 A, fed through fusible link 4).

slots.name: DED18 WIPER
slots.what: Dedicated fuse 18: windshield wiper and washer (Yellow 20 A). Powered from ACC.

layout.smallCaption: DEDICATED 15 – 18 · CONNECTED TO THE JUNCTION BLOCK
